purpose: Ephemeral browser-facing ItemShop session state; does not define prices, inventory rules, or a second transaction engine.

actions.open: resolve source-backed ItemShop offers through existing browser ItemShop runtime
actions.selectOffer: select only a resolved source-backed offer
actions.setQuantity: store positive integer requested by UI; transaction layer remains authoritative for inventory/gold limits
actions.close: reset ephemeral session without Persistent State mutation

transactionBoundary: UI session -> existing NPC ItemShop runtime -> existing Item allocator / Economy transaction -> Persistent State
persistence: ephemeral-controller-session; not written to canonical Persistent State
